chunks.heading: Outreach script
chunks.text: Thank the member for their time, explain that flu shots are covered at no cost at participating pharmacies and doctor offices, and offer to find the nearest pharmacy.
chunks.embedText: Flu Vaccine Outreach Script (2025-2026 Season) | Outreach script | Thank the member for their time, explain that flu shots are covered at no cost at participating pharmacies and doctor offices, and offer to find the nearest pharmacy.

chunks.heading: Incentive
chunks.text: Members who get a flu shot by December 31 earn a reward on their rewards card. This script expires at the end of the 2025-2026 season.
